levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify different kinds of work in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain different kinds of work and connect it to respect for workers without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use childhood imagination in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from Vocation and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on Vocation.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.

_gurukulChapterContext.subject: English
_gurukulChapterContext.contentPolicy: Gurukul-original enrichment grounded in the supplied NCERT chapter; no verbatim textbook prose.
